This means the 10 requests will be postponed to an indefinite period of time and there will be no more transcribing activity.

I love this piece because it reminds me of something important I lost in the past.


Until next season -

I hate it.

Dear fans, and everyone else who supported me in the last few years.

First of all, I have to apologize for my sudden disappearance.
I was a coward for not staying in touch with my fans and I regret that action. But today I finally gathered
enough courage to talk with you again.

To tell you the truth I have a severe depression for the last few weeks.

I won't provide any further details about this matter but let's just say, I am getting very tired. Suddenly, I realized I am a stranger in the entire music conservatorium.
I mean, sure, I get along with some of my fellow students in the conservatorium, enjoying music, meeting up and drink something and discuss the latest music performances but they don't know the "other me".
